Description

Cluster imbalance is a known issue and yeah, we are hitting it. I consistently see oversized clusters (multiples in size of our configured limit). This can lead to inconsistent search latency behavior for different queries (what if the query is nearer only tiny clusters or nearer only the huge ones?) and can harm our logic for fetching postings lists.

We should strive for cluster size consistency, even with SOAR overspilling.
selected_issues.title: [DiskBBQ] Fix our silly imbalanced cluster issue

selected_issues.body_for_case: We should be able to optimize stats of the form SUM(X + a) where a is a constant to SUM(X) + aCOUNT(X). This should result in fewer addition operations, and reuse of SUM(X) if it is used elsewhere in the query. There is a problem with doing this optimization due to multivaluedness. Specifically, if a document has multiple values for X then X+a is null, and does not contribute to the result. For example if there are two documents one with X value 3 and one with values [5, 10], then the query STATS SUM(X), SUM(X + 4) evaluates to 18, 7 because both single and multi values are in the first sum, but only single values are in the ...
selected_issues.title: Query planner rewrite SUM(X+a) as SUM(X) + a*COUNT(X)
